units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 38:5">Yalk. Gen. 38</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 4:23">Gen. IV, 23</cite>) <he>וכי איש אשר הרגתי וכי פצעתיו מזיד שיהא הפ׳ קרוי על שמי</he> was it a man I killed? and did I wound him wilfully, that the wound should be called by my name?; Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:25">Num. R. s. 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01439"><he>פָּצַע</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>פְּצָעִים</he>, constr. <he>פִּצְעֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:13">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> (ref. to Gen. l. c.) <he>דבר שהוא עושה פ׳</he> he struck him with something which makes open wounds (with a stone).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:7">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> <he>שיבואו עלי פ׳ בשבילו</he> that wounds (sufferings) must come upon me on his account? <cite ref="Yevamot 63b:14">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> (quot. fr. Ben Sira) <he>רבים היו פצעי רוכל וכ׳</he> many have been the wounds of the peddlers that lead to indecencies (by selling exciting perfumes); a. fr.
